title: SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15 SP6 and older are past general support
summary: General support ended for SLES 15 SP6 on 2025-12-31, SP5 on 2024-12-31, and SP4 on 2023-12-31, and for SP3 and older earlier. Long Term Service Pack Support is a separate paid add-on; SLES 15 SP7 and SLES 16 remain in general support.

constraints: Use the supported service-pack migration path, or rebuild the host on the target service pack.
Long Term Service Pack Support is a separate paid add-on; do not count it as general support.

steps.title: Upgrade the SLES host
steps.instructions: Move the host to a supported SLES service pack, confirm subscriptions and third-party packages, then return it to service.

verification.purpose: Confirm the host reports the target SLES service pack.
Check that the target repositories are configured and reachable.
